implementation_invariants: Event construction receives only BTC/SOL price frames and cannot inspect predictor values.
All 185 raw 0062 cells and all 17 frozen family scores remain available; result-informed feature pruning is forbidden.
P03 screening uses VALIDATION metrics only; FINAL data cannot re-screen signals.
All hyperparameter selection uses VALIDATION only and follows the preregistered metric hierarchy.
P08 weights are learned from VALIDATION probabilities only and frozen before FINAL/economic evaluation.
The 2024+ event-prediction evaluation cannot alter hyperparameters, signal sets, probability thresholds or controller definitions.
Decision after close t may affect only portfolio return row t+1.
No leverage, no shorting, no production/signer/order path exists in the implementation.
Historical file I/O belongs only to a later exactly-once controlled runner after controlled-boundary merge.
